origin.description: Set control values for iterations within gls: iteration limits, tolerances, optimizer choice, and the approximate variance settings.
origin.usage: glsControl(maxIter = 50L, msMaxIter = 200L, tolerance = 1e-6, msTol = 1e-7, msVerbose = FALSE, singular.ok = FALSE, returnObject = FALSE, apVar = TRUE, .relStep = .Machine$double.eps^(1/3), opt = c("nlminb", "optim"), optimMethod = "BFGS", minAbsParApVar = 0.05, natural = TRUE, sigma = NULL)

arguments.name: maxIter
arguments.text: maximum number of iterations for the gls estimation algorithm

arguments.name: opt
arguments.text: optimizer, nlminb or optim; matched by partial name

arguments.name: sigma
arguments.text: fixed within-group standard deviation; NULL estimates it

origin.details: The function checks sigma and matches opt, then returns the list of settings used by gls.
origin.value: A list with the control settings.

translation.description: Return the gls control settings as a dict with R's list names.

arguments.name: opt
arguments.text: None or a partial match of nlminb/optim

translation.details: sigma must be a finite non-negative length-one number; otherwise ValueError with the R message. opt follows match.arg.
translation.value: A dict whose keys are the R list names (maxIter, msMaxIter, ..., sigma).
translation.example:
from nlme.glscontrol import glsControl

print(glsControl(maxIter=10, opt="optim"))
